hotels.title: NSW Central Coast Luxury Lodges & Boutique Villas with Daily Breakfast & A$100 Resort Credit
hotels.description: Embrace Hamptons-style elegance at this popular boutique retreat on the New South Wales Central Coast. Unplug from the everyday with a high-end escape in a natural paradise, where several sparkling beaches and bays meet the Bouddi National Park. Just a 90-minute drive north from Sydney’s CBD, Bells at Killcare Boutique Hotel, Restaurant & Spa is the perfect base to explore scenic bushwalking trails or stroll along the iconic Killcare Beach. The experience here is truly boutique - start each day with a farm-to-table breakfast at The Wild Flower Bar & Dining, featuring fresh produce from the hotel’s own kitchen garden. Between the soothing treatments at Bells Day Spa and the hotel’s 20-metre lap pool, pool bar, yoga and pilates offerings and wine tasting with the in-house sommelier, you’ll slip effortlessly into a rhythm of relaxation. Whether you retreat to the peaceful villas or the spacious family lodges, this sanctuary offers a true back-to-nature experience.
